items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Good Lord, I've worked with Albert Burbank, George Lewis, Barney and all of them -- you're just as New Orleans as any of those three men.

ctx.x: Good Lord, I've worked with Albert Burbank, George Lewis, Barney and all of them -- you're just as New Orleans as any of those three men.
Ed Hall didn't come from New Orleans.
